# ffxf_database_backups (Data Source)

Reads FFXF Cloud database API data. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_database_backups" "current" {
  database_id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) ID of the database to query.

### Read-Only

- `backups_json` (String) Backups available for point-in-time restore as JSON.
- `restore_window_json` (String) Earliest and latest restorable timestamps as JSON.
